args.title: Saltmarsh Foods Newsletter: Retail Returns Logistics
args.body:
• Newsletter: Saltmarsh Foods' latest newsletter covers retail returns logistics, linking to its blog article and holding a seat for Hana at the related webinar.
• Article: Apparel return rates have reached 24%, and consolidating return hubs has cut handling costs by a fifth.
• Companion piece: Reselling returned items within 10 days preserves most of the margin.
